SELECT b.id, b.is_deleted, b.start_date, b.end_date, b.bed_details, b.customer_id, b.bed_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_sex FROM beddetails b LEFT JOIN customer c ON (b.customer_id = c.id)
and c.customer_name like concat('%','${detailsDTO.customerName}','%')
and b.start_date >= #{detailsDTO.startDate} and #{detailsDTO.endDate} >= b.start_date
and b.is_deleted = #{detailsDTO.isDeleted}
order by b.end_date desc
